title: kystdatahuset-apiclient
text:
A Python client for the Kystdatahuset REST API.
See the README for installation and command-line usage, and the Reference for the Python API.

title: core.client.KystdataClient
text:
core.client.KystdataClient(base_url=BASE_URL)





Name
Description




login
Authenticates with Kystdatahuset and saves the returned JWT bearer token.


logout
Clears the local session state. The Kystdatahuset API does not expose a


lookup_ship
Resolves a ship record using the authenticated session.


lookup_ships_for_mmsis
Resolves ship records for a batch of MMSI numbers.


request
Perform a raw request against an arbitrary API endpoint.





core.client.KystdataClient.login(username, password, csrf_token)
Authenticates with Kystdatahuset and saves the returned JWT bearer token.



core.client.KystdataClient.logout()
Clears the local session state. The Kystdatahuset API does not expose a logout endpoint, so this only drops the locally held tokens and credentials.



core.client.KystdataClient.lookup_ship(value, key='mmsi')
Resolves a ship record using the authenticated session.



core.client.KystdataClient.lookup_ships_for_mmsis(mmsis)
Resolves ship records for a batch of MMSI numbers.
.. note:: This dataset is licensed; the authenticated user needs the Kystdatahuset_ekstern_alle role (or higher) to access it.



core.client.KystdataClient.request(
    endpoint,
    method='GET',
    params=None,
    json_payload=None,
)
Perform a raw request against an arbitrary API endpoint.
:param endpoint: Endpoint path, relative to the API base url, e.g. kystinfo/norvts-incidents :param method: HTTP method to use, e.g. GET or POST :param params: Query string parameters :param json_payload: JSON request body
